pages.text: Welcome to $(thing)Xulai Seed Seasons$()!$(br2)This mod builds on top of Serene Seasons to give crops a full $(crop)season-based farming cycle$().$(br2)It adds four systems:$(li)$(l:seedseasons:crop_seasons/welcome)Crop seasons$(/l)$(li)$(l:seedseasons:crop_lifecycle/welcome)Day-based crop growth$(/l)$(li)$(l:seedseasons:water_management/welcome)Water consumption$(/l)$(li)$(l:seedseasons:seasonal_daynight/welcome)Seasonal day & night length$(/l)

pages.title: How to read this guide
pages.text: Each chapter explains one system.$(br2)Use the $(bold)Index$() button on the landing page to search, or the $(bold)History$() button to go back to what you just read.$(br2)You can $(italic)shift-click$() items shown in this book to jump to their crafting page, and hover over $(item)highlighted items$() for their tooltips.
